focus_area: WebSocket completion broadcast — SPEC §7 in full (ExtractJobCriteriaJob signature, three broadcast sites, broadcast_completion helper, §12 broadcast test coverage)

findings.title: Exhaustion-site broadcast is unreachable: broadcast_completion raises NoMethodError inside the retry_on block (self is the class, not the job instance)
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC §7: "In the retry_on exhaustion block (after the existing update_columns(status: :failed, ...), line 9): look up the row and broadcast ONLY when the row exists" — the broadcast must actually fire at exhaustion when the row exists.
findings.evidence: app/jobs/extract_job_criteria_job.rb:11 — the retry_on CustomErrorAiSummary exhaustion block calls broadcast_completion(ai_job_criteria, job.arguments.second), but broadcast_completion is a private INSTANCE method (defined at line 39 under the private keyword at line 37). In activejob 6.1.7.7 (the repo's bundled version), retry_on invokes the exhaustion block via `yield self, error` inside the rescue_from handler (activejob-6.1.7.7/lib/active_job/exceptions.rb:63-64). `yield` uses plain block-call semantics and does NOT rebind self; the block's self is its lexical definition context — the class body — so self inside the exhaustion block is the ExtractJobCriteriaJob CLASS object, on which no broadcast_completion method exists (ApplicationJob is empty; no class-level definition anywhere in app/jobs/). Verified empirically against the repo's bundle with a standalone probe job: inside the retry_on exhaustion block, self.inspect == 'ProbeJob' (the class) and calling a private instance method raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'private_helper' for ProbeJob:Class`. Runtime consequence when the 3rd CustomErrorAiSummary attempt exhausts: line 10's update_columns(status: :failed, ...) runs (row correctly marked failed), then line 11 raises NoMethodError out of the exhaustion handler — the job dies with NoMethodError instead of completing, the spec-required JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE broadcast never fires, the requesting user gets no toast, and the frontend never invalidates the aiJobCriteria query (button spins until manual reload — exactly the outcome the failure-broadcast requirement exists to prevent, SPEC §7 flagged deviation rationale (a)). Note: the cited analog has the IDENTICAL latent defect (app/jobs/generate_ai_job_application_summary_job.rb:20 calls the private instance method broadcast_completion from its own retry_on exhaustion block), so the implementation faithfully mirrors the analog's structure — but the spec's behavioral requirement is a broadcast at exhaustion, and this code cannot execute one. The adjudicated ruling (flag 4) covers only the positional-vs-kwargs argument deviation, not this. The suite cannot catch it: SPEC §12's required broadcast tests (success, zero-criteria, StandardError, CustomErrorAiSummary re-enqueue with no broadcast, no-requesting-user) never reach the exhaustion block — the CustomErrorAiSummary example (spec/jobs/extract_job_criteria_job_spec.rb:138-155) asserts re-enqueue on the FIRST failure (executions < attempts), so the exhaustion handler never runs in any test.
findings.recommendation: Make the exhaustion-site broadcast actually executable, e.g. invoke the helper through the job instance the block already receives (`job.send(:broadcast_completion, ai_job_criteria, job.arguments.second)`) or restructure broadcast_completion so it is callable from the block's class-level context — and add a behavioral exhaustion test (drive executions to the attempts limit, assert GlobalChannel receives broadcast_to with action 'JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE' and status 'failed', falsifiable per pipeline rule 26). Surface to Jessica that the analog generate_ai_job_application_summary_job.rb:20 shares the same latent defect (its exhaustion broadcast also cannot fire) — fixing the analog is outside this feature's diff and needs her call, per pipeline rules 10/23.

requirements_checked: SPEC §7: perform signature `def perform(ai_job_criteria_id, requesting_organization_user_id = nil)` (adjudicated flag 4 positional)
SPEC §7: perform-site broadcast after extract, gated `if requesting_organization_user_id`, skipped while CustomErrorAiSummary retry propagates (re-raise precedes it)

SPEC §7: broadcast_completion helper matching the spec code block — OrganizationUser lookup, user guard, fresh-read AiJobCriteria.find_by (amended spec form), terminal-status guard (succeeded/failed only), payload keys status/jobId/jobTitle/zeroCriteriaFailure + conditional errorMessage, GlobalChannel.broadcast_to with action 'JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE'
Diff-to-spec: every change in app/jobs/extract_job_criteria_job.rb traces to §7 (verified against develop's version; the Rails.logger.error line and update_columns failure writes pre-exist)

SPEC §12: spec/jobs/extract_job_criteria_job_spec.rb behavioral broadcast coverage — success broadcast, zero-criteria broadcast (zeroCriteriaFailure true + errorMessage), StandardError failed broadcast, CustomErrorAiSummary re-enqueue with NO broadcast, no-requesting-user no broadcast (success and failure variants)
spec_coverage.notes: Textually the file matches SPEC §7 line-for-line: the signature, all three broadcast call sites with exactly the spec's guard conditions, and a broadcast_completion helper verbatim to the spec's amended code block (fresh-read find_by form). All five §12-required broadcast tests exist and are falsifiable — the success test even exercises the fresh-read behaviorally (the service double writes succeeded via update_columns while the in-memory row stays pending, so a stale-object helper would fail the terminal guard and the test). GlobalChannel.broadcast_to targets stream_for current_user (global_channel.rb:5), consistent with the analog's consumption path. The one failure is behavioral, not textual: the exhaustion-site broadcast (finding l1-a5-001) can never execute — activejob 6.1.7.7 runs retry_on exhaustion blocks with self bound to the class, so the private-instance-method call raises NoMethodError (verified empirically against the repo's bundle). The analog carries the identical latent defect at generate_ai_job_application_summary_job.rb:20, which is why structural mirroring reproduced it; §12 requires no exhaustion-path test, which is why the suite is green anyway. Counted as missing=1 because the spec-required exhaustion broadcast behavior is absent at runtime despite the code being present.
